nodes.description: Public address of the protocol governance, initialized to msg.sender in the constructor.
Mapping granting privileged minting/burning rights; only governance is set to true at deploy time.
Private constant-like initial mint amount (500) multiplied by 10**decimals at deployment.
Private address slot that is never read in the contract but can be overwritten by anyone via nonSense().
Private mapping of account balances mutated by _transfer, _initMint, _hashRefuel, _burn and _hashSwap.
Private nested mapping of owner->spender->amount approvals mutated by _approve.
Private total supply, increased by mint/refuel and decreased by burn/hashSwap.
Token name string set once in the ERC20Detailed constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the ERC20Detailed constructor.
Token decimals (uint8) set in the ERC20Detailed constructor and used for the initial mint scaling.
Deployment constructor: assigns governance = msg.sender, mints initAmt_ scaled supply and whitelists governance as a hashMaker.
Public function gated by require(hashMakers[msg.sender]) that calls _hashSwap on an attacker-chosen account.
Public function gated by require(hashMakers[msg.sender]) that mints an arbitrary amount to an arbitrary account via _hashRefuel.
Unrestricted public setter that overwrites the unused sense state variable with any caller-supplied address.
Internal routine that reads an account balance, zeroes it and subtracts the same amount from _totalSupply without burning event or authorization of the victim.
Internal routine that increases _totalSupply and credits an arbitrary account without emitting a Transfer event.
Internal one-time style mint used by the HashTagProtocol constructor to credit the deployer.
Internal transfer that debits sender and credits recipient using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
Internal approval writer that sets _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding _msgSender() as sender to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves funds then decreases the spender allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 approve setting the caller's allowance for a spender.
Public allowance increase helper using SafeMath.add.
Public allowance decrease helper using SafeMath.sub.
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public view returning _totalSupply.
Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Internal view helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Sets the token name, symbol and decimals at deployment.
Public view returning _decimals, used for scaling the initial mint.
Public view returning the token name.
Public view returning the token symbol.
Library addition that performs raw uint addition and requires c >= a.
Library subtraction that requires b <= a before subtracting.
Library multiplication with a zero short-circuit and overflow require.
Library division that requires b > 0.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization (hashMakers lookup, governance assignment) and as the implicit sender of transfers/approvals.
Any address whitelisted in hashMakers can zero the balance of an arbitrary account and reduce totalSupply, a privileged destructive operation guarded only by a plain require.
Any address whitelisted in hashMakers can mint an arbitrary amount to an arbitrary account, silently inflating supply without a Transfer event.
Public function with no access control writes the sense state variable to any caller supplied address; the variable is never validated or used elsewhere.
Raw unchecked arithmetic expression (a + b) whose overflow safety depends entirely on the following require.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes governance and is self-whitelisted as a hashMaker during deployment.
hashSwap authorizes the caller by looking up hashMakers[msg.sender].
hashRefuel authorizes the caller by looking up hashMakers[msg.sender].
transfer uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the debited account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is reduced.
approve grants an allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
increaseAllowance reads and writes the caller allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the caller allowance entry.
_msgSender returns msg.sender unchanged.

amount parameter is credited to the minted account.

operand a enters the raw addition.

name constructor argument written to _name.
symbol constructor argument written to _symbol.

constructor sets governance to the deployer address.
constructor whitelists governance in hashMakers, granting privileged mint/burn rights.
hashSwap reads hashMakers[msg.sender] as its only authorization gate.
hashRefuel reads hashMakers[msg.sender] as its only authorization gate.
nonSense overwrites the sense state variable with caller input.
_hashSwap reads and then zeroes _balances[acc].
_hashSwap decrements _totalSupply by the captured balance.
_hashRefuel credits _balances[account].
_hashRefuel increases _totalSupply, inflating supply silently.
_initMint credits _balances[account].
_initMint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_transfer writes both debited and credited entries of _balances.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
hashSwap invokes _hashSwap on the attacker-chosen account after the hashMaker check.
hashRefuel invokes _hashRefuel on the attacker-chosen account and amount after the hashMaker check.
hashSwap exposes a privileged arbitrary-balance wipe reachable by any whitelisted address.
hashRefuel exposes a privileged arbitrary mint reachable by any whitelisted address.
nonSense performs an unrestricted state write from an external caller.
SafeMath.add relies on a post-hoc require to guard raw uint overflow.
constructor mints the initial supply through _initMint.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
